content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To be safe while pregnant, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Schedule a comprehensive prenatal screening (1 hour)
Step 2. Research local obstetricians (3 hours)
Step 3. Confirm pregnancy with a home test (10 minutes)
Step 4. Begin taking prenatal vitamins with folic acid (5 minutes)
Step 5. Attend a newborn care workshop (4 hours)
Step 6. Register for a hospital maternity tour (30 minutes)
Step 7. Create a list of emergency contact numbers (20 minutes)
Step 8. Purchase comfortable, supportive footwear (1 hour)
Step 9. Undergo initial blood work panels (45 minutes)
Step 10. Install a nursery carbon monoxide detector (15 minutes)
Step 11. Call the insurance provider to verify coverage (30 minutes)
Step 12. Audit household cleaning supplies for toxins (2 hours)
Step 13. Review workplace maternity leave policies (1 hour)
Step 14. Schedule a dental checkup for gum health (1 hour)
Step 15. Join a pregnancy support group (1.5 hours)
Step 16. Switch to low-impact aerobic exercise (45 minutes)
Step 17. Update the family medical history file (2 hours)
Step 18. Interview potential doulas or birth coaches (3 hours)
Step 19. Start a pregnancy symptom journal (15 minutes)
Step 20. Professional cleaning of dental plaque (1 hour)
Step 21. Verify the OB-GYN accepts your insurance (20 minutes)
Step 22. Attend a consultation on gestational nutrition (1 hour)
Step 23. Pack a basic hospital "go-bag" (2 hours)
Step 24. Discuss birth plan preferences with a partner (2 hours)
Step 25. Research umbilical cord blood banking (3 hours)
Step 26. Read a book on fetal development (5 hours)
Step 27. Purchase a firm maternity support pillow (30 minutes)
Step 28. Set up a digital calendar for appointments (30 minutes)
Step 29. Prepare a list of questions for the doctor (1 hour)
Step 30. Attend the first trimester ultrasound (1 hour)
Step 31. Review results of the glucose tolerance test (15 minutes)
Step 32. Consult with a pharmacist about current medications (30 minutes)
Step 33. Schedule the second trimester anatomy scan (15 minutes)
Step 34. Check the home for lead paint or environmental hazards (4 hours)
Step 35. Install the infant car seat (1 hour)
Step 36. Evaluate the safety of the current fitness routine (1 hour)
Step 37. Document the baby's movement patterns (30 minutes)
Step 38. Take a childproofing survey of the kitchen (1 hour)
Step 39. Finalize the formal birth plan document (2 hours)
Step 40. Purchase a high-quality blood pressure monitor (30 minutes)
Step 41. Record baseline blood pressure readings (10 minutes)
Step 42. Discuss preeclampsia signs with a nurse (20 minutes)
Step 43. Request a Tdap vaccination for family members (15 minutes)
Step 44. Get the seasonal flu shot (15 minutes)
Step 45. Complete a hospital pre-registration form (30 minutes)
Step 46. Cut out high-mercury fish from the diet (10 minutes)
Step 47. Attend a class on infant CPR (3 hours)
Step 48. Establish a remote work arrangement if needed (2 days)
Step 49. Participate in a breastfeeding education class (3 hours)
Step 50. Wash and sanitize all new baby clothes (4 hours)
Step 51. Buy a certified safe crib and mattress (2 hours)
Step 52. Submit a formal maternity leave request (30 minutes)
Step 53. Prepare and freeze healthy post-birth meals (6 hours)
Step 54. Identify the fastest route to the hospital (1 hour)
Step 55. Practice pelvic floor strengthening exercises (20 minutes)
Step 56. Schedule a 28-week checkup (15 minutes)
Step 57. Sign up for a pediatric meet-and-greet (1 hour)
Step 58. Visit a physical therapist for back alignment (1 hour)
Step 59. Install a baby gate at the top of the stairs (45 minutes)
Step 60. Finalize the nursery layout for safety (2 hours)
Step 61. Test the nursery smoke alarms (10 minutes)
Step 62. Buy a non-slip mat for the bathtub (15 minutes)
Step 63. Hire a professional to check the water heater (2 hours)
Step 64. Assemble the baby's bassinet (1 hour)
Step 65. Dispose of expired medications safely (30 minutes)
Step 66. Secure heavy furniture to the walls (3 hours)
Step 67. Learn about safe sleeping positions (30 minutes)
Step 68. Take a prenatal yoga class (1 hour)
Step 69. Pack the baby's coming-home outfit (20 minutes)
Step 70. Sign up for a local emergency alert system (10 minutes)
Step 71. Purchase a thermometer and first aid kit (30 minutes)
Step 72. Adjust the height of the computer monitor (15 minutes)
Step 73. Attend a third trimester growth scan (1 hour)
Step 74. Read the hospital's visitor policy (20 minutes)
Step 75. Sanitize all bottles and pump parts (1 hour)
Step 76. Review signs of active labor (1 hour)
Step 77. Rest and focus on mental preparation (8 hours)
Step 78. Set up a bedside nursing station (1 hour)
Step 79. Confirm the pediatrician's contact info (15 minutes)
Step 80. Purchase a pregnancy tracking app (5 minutes)
